uninitialized_target: Preserve explicit raw table_txn=null and table_row_count=null; require independent actual total COUNT0 with strict LONG type plus settled writerTxn=sequencerTxn=0. Source transactions must be initialized. target_actual_row_counts and target_actual_row_counts_after cover exactly both owner targets; counts enter strict runtime frontier only, not stable unit fingerprint.
unknown_anchor: known_source_date=false; cache records empty; expected_receipt=null; actual current key absence checked; publish rejected
known_empty_join: known_source_date=true; cache records empty; expected_receipt.row_count=0 and original empty digest; cache key absent before/after
fingerprints: sources_fingerprint hashes three source snapshots; targets_fingerprint hashes target snapshots. source_fingerprint hashes stable dataset/date/original business generation/source vector/full expected cache+receipt/raw census/SQL+owner files/stable target_id. It excludes target transactions, hit/miss/key absence, invocation and time. All runtime target frontiers, existing keys/receipts, hits and exact PID remain separate strict publication preconditions. Stable target_id is questdb-SHA256(root/host/ports/two physical IDs/directories/schemas), excluding process PID.

prepared_job.immutable_caller_evidence: intent and SQLite responseEvidence bind prepared_input_path and prepared_input_sha256; complete snake_case rows and canonicalPayloadLines match exact Java UTF8 payload fingerprint and all five values

timestamp_encoding: Full UTC timestamp ending Z, midnight for cache/coverage trade_date; Java converts to BusinessDate after validating exact midnight
process_evidence: Python reports its PID/start/terminal response and stopped direct ILP senders, no child senders. exit_observed remains false; Java must record actual process termination before uncertain-sender reconciliation.
